name_reason: Name already complies with global naming convention (data_fd2_<domain>_<descriptor>) and accurately reflects both the domain (chapter-03 end scene) and the data type (table). 'ch03' is a meaningful chapter ID (chapters 01-30), not a Ghidra address residue, so it must be kept. '_facing_table' correctly identifies this as the per-character sprite facing-direction table (third of three parallel 7-byte placement tables: pos_x @ 0x520BA, pos_y @ 0x520C1, facing @ 0x520C8). Sibling tables use the identical naming pattern, so it is consistent.
purpose: Chapter-3 end-scene character placement: per-character sprite facing direction (0..3) for the 7 characters staged in the chapter-3 recruit cutscene (recruit 劍士鐵諾, char #2).
logic_summary: Read-only const byte table. Reader fd2_chapter_03_end @ 0x230F2 block-copies the 7 bytes (MOV ESI,0x520C8; MOV EDI,ESP; MOVSD/MOVSW/MOVSB = 4+2+1 = 7 bytes) onto an on-stack placement block (recruit_block_c), then passes that block as the facing-direction argument (3rd positional arg, after pos_x block and pos_y block) to fd2_setup_chars_and_camera_for_intro @ 0x233C6. Each entry is consumed one byte at a time; no struct stride, no wider access, no sign extension. Only reached on the live-survivor branch (runtime_char[6] alive), which also triggers dialog page 7 and recruits char #2.
element_semantics: Per-character sprite facing direction code (0..3) for the 7 characters placed in the chapter-3 recruit cutscene; index i corresponds to placement slot i (parallel to the pos_x/pos_y tables). Values: {2,2,2,3,1,2,0}.
